problem: Current main freezes one semantic contract but pre-freeze authorship is distributed: the sole writer sees deployment capability identities/guidance and validators can prescribe replacement semantic structures. The exact matcher therefore lacks a capability-independent semantic join.

options.name: 仅隐藏 capability index 并保留现有 requested_effect exact identity
options.correctness: 消除直接泄漏，但盲写者可为同一受支持含义产生不同开放名称，造成系统性 false negative；不能消除 validator replacement feedback。
options.verification: 无法证明开放语义命名与现有 capability identity 一致，因此不足。

options.name: 在现有 Module/FrozenSemanticContract/Capability v2 上增加 capability-independent semantic output 与 exact coverage
options.correctness: 恢复单 Writer；semantic vocabulary 与 capability availability 分离；freeze 后机器精确 coverage；unsupported 不 nearest-match。
options.complexity: 中等，复用现有模块注册、冻结合同、Capability v2、CapabilityGate。
options.migration: A2/B 原子切换新 turn；历史 frozen checkpoint 仅保留显式兼容读取。
options.rollback: A2/B 整体回退，不允许半回退。
options.verification: 结构、正反例、Quick/Integration、protected live-model adversarial matrix 分层证明。

options.name: 新建完整独立 semantics/ontology/planner 主链并替换现有 lifecycle/module runtime
options.correctness: 理论边界清晰，但会创建大规模并行迁移面并触碰大量已稳定权威。
options.migration: 需要新旧主链长时间 shadow/cutover。
options.verification: 需要更大范围全栈认证，超出 #550 当前缺陷闭包。

rejected_reasons.conservative-prompt-hide-only: 不能同时解决 canonical semantic join 与 validator semantic-authority drift，且会把当前误匹配风险替换成系统性 false negative。
rejected_reasons.redesign-new-semantics-stack: 不必要扩大主链、事务、展示与持久化迁移面，违反复用现有 FrozenSemanticContract/Module/Capability v2 的最小架构变更原则。

deletions: 删除 provider-bound goal declaration 对 capability_effect_index/capability semantic guidance 的读取权。
删除 requested_effect 必须对齐当前部署 effect identity 的 pre-freeze 指令。
删除 validator writer-facing repair feedback 中 replacement dependency/effect/semantic-role 值的权力。
新 turn 切换后删除 legacy requested_effect identity 作为新执行 coverage 权威的职责。
unknowns: 完整 semantic vocabulary 的长期扩展治理需在本批建立最小通用契约后继续由各 Module 声明。
protected live DeepSeek 对新的 requested-output schema 的稳定性必须在合并候选通过确定性 Gate 后独立认证。
Phase C UNIQUE historical-reference deterministic target compiler 留在后续独立 bounded batch。
selected_responsibilities: Semantic Writer 从 capability-independent module semantic vocabulary 产生 requested-output candidate。
Semantic validators only PASS/REJECT/CLARIFY and expose grounded violations, never replacement semantic answers。
FrozenSemanticContract normalizes, freezes and integrity-binds requested outputs once。
ModuleRegistry aggregates semantic vocabulary independently from CapabilityRegistry。
Capabilities reference semantic output IDs they can exactly cover; capability availability never defines vocabulary existence。
Post-freeze capability_effects/coverage compiler grants frontier eligibility only by exact requested-output set coverage。
Goal completion evidence uses the same exact coverage relation for new turns。
Historical checkpoint compatibility is explicit, read-only and non-authoritative for newly declared turns。
preserved_hard_invariants: FrozenSemanticContract remains the sole formal turn semantics after acceptance。
CapabilityGate and ExecutionPermit remain mandatory before dispatch。
Draft/Grant/Attempt/Receipt and structured-interaction authorization are unchanged。
No exact semantic output coverage means no execution。
No new WP-08 ReleaseRun without human authorization。
cutover_strategy: Implement semantic vocabulary contribution, requested-output freeze/integrity, violation-only validator feedback and exact capability coverage in one A2/B candidate. Provider-bound new declarations use the new output contract immediately; only already-frozen historical checkpoints without it may read the legacy effect identity. Do not merge a state where capability hints are hidden but exact requested-output coverage is not yet available.
acceptance_claims: Pre-freeze writer payload and schema contain no deployment capability names/identities/availability/guidance/examples。
Semantic vocabulary may contain an output with zero installed capabilities and therefore does not reveal availability。
Validator public repair feedback never contains a replacement dependency graph, requested output/effect, target meaning or recommended Goal role。
Frozen requested outputs are integrity-bound and cannot be rewritten after freeze。
Logistics current-status/ETA outputs obtain exact coverage; courier contact phone obtains none and deterministically routes unsupported。
Mixed supported + unsupported sibling outcomes remain separate。
Legacy effect identity cannot become the coverage authority for a new requested-output turn。
Existing transaction/business fact/public response authority boundaries remain green。
baseline_changes: No Architecture Baseline policy promotion is requested in this batch; this restores the selected V20.11.1 ownership boundary。
Product source changes are limited to the exact ChangePermit scope plus focused tests。
Phase C target compilation and WP-08 reauthorization are outside this Change Contract。
